It does NOT mean the swept set is provably clean: see `known_limitation` in this same file, and note that adversarial review rounds 1 and 3 both found errors inside occurrences this sweep had read and passed.

what_this_sample_cannot_detect.reading: 0 error(s) found in 240 is consistent with the residuals known to remain: they imply a rate well below what a sample of this size can resolve, so a draw that happens to miss them is expected rather than suspicious. The claim is the Wilson upper bound, not the point estimate — this draw rules out error rates above the figure named here, and says nothing about rates beneath it.
